title: Unbounded HTTP response read and gzip decompression from remote mirror
evidence:
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=600, context=ctx) as resp:
                body = resp.read()
                if resp.headers.get("Content-Encoding") == "gzip":
                    body = gzip.decompress(body)
detail: Response body is read and gzip-decompressed with no size cap; a compromised or abusive mirror could exhaust dev-machine memory. Pinned HTTPS endpoints and dev-only use keep risk low.
recommended_fix: Stream-read with an explicit byte budget (check Content-Length, bounded incremental read) before gzip.decompress.

title: Silent exception swallow around TLS trust-store setup
detail: CA-bundle load failures are swallowed without logging. Verification stays enabled (fail-closed), but the silent catch hides the cause, invites verification-disabling 'fixes', and violates project-context's no-silent-catch rule.
recommended_fix: Catch only ModuleNotFoundError/ssl.SSLError and log which CA store is being used.
